items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I heard lots about him. I remember John McMurray.

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to play on a single-headed snare drum, like a banjo hit.
Yeah, McMurray, let's see. I remember, yeah, John McMurray. Let's see. No, John... I heard lots about him. I remember John McMurray. I mean, I've seen him too much in person.
You tell me what this snare drum would be like. You ever seen a single-headed snare drum?
